RIGHT-facing fullbody profile, two hands on katana. Distinct downward diagonal slash with body weight:1low ready both knees bent blade ahead;2draw blade OVER head behind shoulder while back leg stores force and hips rotate;3push from rear foot and turn hips bringing blade diagonally downward across front of chest;4impact low forward lunge with front knee bent, blade low ahead, rear heel raised;5follow-through hips rotated and blade near front shin, arms bend to brake;6recover feet/hips and katana to low ready. Show real blade each frame, preparation→impact→follow-through→recovery, no slash effects needed. Don't simply rotate weapon while standing still. Same character anatomy and uniform scale (standing equiv80%square), soles90%, complete curved blade/hilt/sheath and body within16px equivalent margins. Six equal square cells horizontal row, one soldier/action per cell. Opaque flat pure#FF00FF no shadow text grid borders. Compact overhead arms and footstep rather than shrinking character.
